settings.question: How long does delivery take across India?
settings.answer: We dispatch all confirmed orders within 24 hours from regional fulfillment centers in Mumbai and Delhi. Metro deliveries typically arrive in 2-3 business days, while other regional destinations take 3-5 business days. You can track live parcel milestones on our Order Tracking page.

settings.question: How does the 7-Day Doorstep Replacement Guarantee work?
settings.answer: If your product is physically damaged on arrival, defective in audio/function, or incorrect in size, you can initiate a doorstep return within 7 calendar days of delivery via your Orders page. Our courier will inspect and pick up the item directly from your home address.

settings.question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) supported?
settings.answer: Yes! Cash on Delivery is supported across 19,000+ PIN codes in India for orders up to ₹10,000. You can also pay the delivery agent via UPI QR scan at your doorstep upon receiving the parcel.

settings.question: How do I claim brand warranty on electronics?
settings.answer: All consumer electronics purchased on Kartzo are 100% genuine sealed retail units and include official manufacturer warranty cards. Simply keep your digital tax invoice (downloadable from your Orders page) and present it at any authorized service center.

settings.question: How do I apply promotional coupon KARTZO10?
settings.answer: During checkout or inside your Shopping Cart, enter KARTZO10 in the voucher code field and click Apply to instantly deduct 10% from your order total.

settings.question: What if I need to cancel my order before dispatch?
settings.answer: You can cancel your order at zero charge prior to courier dispatch by navigating to My Orders and clicking 'Cancel Order'. If already in transit, you may simply refuse delivery at your doorstep for an automatic refund.
